name: Normannognathus
isnote: Recovered as a germanodactylid, a basal dsungaripteroid, an indeterminate monofenestratan, or as sister to Cycnorhamphus in Gallodactylidae (Longrich et al. 2018).
sum: Small crested pterodactyloid from the Kimmeridgian of Normandy, France.
holotype: MGCL 59'583 (Musée Géologique Cantonal de Lausanne) — Argiles d'Octeville Formation, Cap de la Hève, Normandy.
material: Left front of a skull with associated lower jaws (~10 cm).
exceptional: Tall wave-shaped crest with a fibrous texture, perhaps from a horn sheath.
biology: Robust teeth reaching the very tip of the jaws.
author: Buffetaut et al. 1998

species.name: Normannognathus wellnhoferi
species.author: Buffetaut et al. 1998
